caption: The drawing depicts a female doll figure with pale skin and short, wavy black hair. She is wearing a long, full-skirted dress with blue and white diagonal stripes. The dress features a high neck, long sleeves, and is decorated with round blue buttons or pom-poms down the back, along the sleeves, and along the skirt in evenly spaced vertical rows. The hem of the dress has a wide ruffled trim of the same blue and white striped fabric. The figure's shoes are black. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller image of the same doll, shown lifting her skirt slightly to reveal a white petticoat adorned with a brown geometric border pattern and the same black shoes. The background is plain light beige, and the artist's signature, "Edith Towner," is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Doll with China Head
